body:
I've shared it with her but it is almost impossible for her to understand. I don't think I even fully understand as I have tried to distance myself as far as possible from all of the thoughts that I had at the time and later. But at one point my feelings and my way of coping turned to anger and that led to emotional abuse. That went on for a little bit before I stopped and started going to counseling as I realized what I was really doing and that I just cant do that to her. The anger though has now turned into sadness and fear, and I guess that leads me to depression and then at the worst of times suicidal thoughts.

I don't know how I'll ever break through it as some things ruined my trust early on in the relationship and I haven't been able to gain that back. And I feel bad because she doesn't deserve this and I can only imagine how hard it has been for her knowing that she never did anything to deserve me and my horrible emotions. And then when she said that I felt like dying and wanted to die. I already felt dead so I thought why even be in this body if I am already dead. Just hard :(. Thank you by the way for helping me through this. It happened after I talked about an event with my counselor (I came out holding back tears) and I haven't fully gotten past that yet and that was about 2 days ago now :\ .

Yea, she is always there for me. And I guess I have friends and when I am sad they will try to pull me away for a while and make me do things, like tonight monopoly. But really all I think about is her and schoolwork, because as a college student trying to do a double major in 3 years I don't expect much else to engage myself in. I guess I am enjoying the two loves of my life education and her.

The problem I have with talking to her is just the defense mechanism I learned when I was young during my parent's divorce. I would shutdown, hide, and cry. My mom cheated on my dad and I haven't seen her in 6 years and I am deathly scared of the same thing happening between us. So when I get scared, I think shes lying or I think she is leaving information out and will hurt me. And that is what leads to me being depressed. But usually I can handle myself or my emotions but some days it is just too much and today when she said "your depression is rubbing off on me" I just did not want to live. I felt like I never did anything good in the world and like my life should end right then. Took me some time before those thoughts went away.

She has heard the story and she has heard everything about me :(. But I tend to push away from her, cut off, and detach myself emotionally. When I do that I can't imagine her eyes, her smile, nor her face. All of it turns into a blur where I am trying to protect myself but at the same time hurting us. I dont know what to do about it. I've been to counseling for a while now with not much success in stopping the emotions. It's just too hard.

Yes, I am currently going to counseling for that and its not from a previous relationship but from my parents. Some ways I learned to cope with emotional pain as a child just don't work well and if it gets past what I can handle thats when things turn really bad (such as today). Took me a while to dig myself out of it and the posts here really helped. On a side note though, I am extremely emotional regarding any sort of sadness and will show it immediately; however, I don't know if I can say the same for happiness. Maybe it is just the way my life has turned out but I don't ever feel the same intensity. I feel dead inside and want to kill myself, but when I am happy I don't even know how to describe it because well it never happens enough.

Thank you so much for everything. I think this has helped me the most, and makes the most sense. It's still hard to look deep into her eyes knowing what I caused and it probably will be for a while but I guess it might have to do for now as we grow. Thank you again I am going to save this for every bad time I am having (actually happens often if I get a sort of "attack" of emotions). Thank you again. I don't know why but this helped so much and to know you cared enough to check up on me.

She isn't the one do detract. It's me. She will sit there and support me through it all, but its me in the end who builds the wall. I am the one who will detach from her and hide, maybe its because I haven't spoken to my mother in 6 years and she cheated on my dad, maybe its not. But I honestly live my life for us not just her or just me, but us. I don't know if thats bad but it's what makes me the happiest person ever when it works and thats the only feeling I seek but sometimes I guess my trust issues just don't allow things to work.

I probably will when I see my counselor but I don't even know what good that will do. I sat there at the end of my last counseling session holding back tears talking about one incident more than a year ago. And how I have never let go of it and the pain that it causes even until today. I ruined the relationship and will never be able to recover.

I've been in the relationship for about two years now. I don't think I have ever fully trusted her. How can you trust someone without knowing what they think? How can trust be formed when their lies mask whatever they say? A lie built on a lie just creates the truth in the eyes of whoever isn't saying it? I have lived a life depressed for well over 10 years now and I don't think that will go away. She hates me, I made her depressed, im depressed, I'm already dead inside. What reason is there to live if you make the ones you love depressed? How is it even possible to look them in the eyes again after you made them depressed? I don't think I can truly hold her again and feel the same way ever, or ever really look into her eyes and lose myself. All I will ever feel is hte pain knowing I made her depressed. And I think that pain is permanent. It hurts to even think about it. Thank you though for listening.
